events.title: Oil Extends Losses As Traders Weigh Supply Glut Risks
events.description: Oil prices traded lower on Monday, entering a fourth week of declines on expectations of rising global supply.

events.title: European Shares Modestly Higher As Tech Stocks Rebound
events.description: European stocks inched higher on Monday after posting their steepest weekly decline since late March 2025, reflecting waning enthusiasm for artificial intelligence-related bets.

events.title: Asian Shares Retreat As Tech Selloff Deepens
events.description: Asian stocks tumbled on Monday as a tech sell-off deepened on growing concerns over the sustainability of the AI boom and the prospect of faster Fed tightening.

events.title: European Shares Poised For Firm Start
events.description: European stocks are seen opening broadly higher on Monday despite lingering worries over the artificial intelligence sector's ability to drive economic growth and the unresolved U.S.-Israeli war against Iran.

events.title: Indian Shares Off Day's Lows As IT Stocks Surge
events.description: Indian shares opened lower on Monday, tracking a sell-off in global markets sparked by an unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is trimming its early losses in mid-market trading on Monday, extending the losses in the previous seven sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,600.00 level, with weakness in financial and technology stocks nearly offset by gains in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets A Sea Of Red Amid Tech Selloff
events.description: Asian markets are a sea of red on Monday, following the negative cues from Wall Street on Friday, dragged by a selloff in semiconductor stocks, particularly in South Korea, mirroring their peers on tech-heavy Nasdaq amid concerns over tighter AI regulations and controls over chip export. The intermittent escalation in the geopolitical tensions in the Middle East also weighed on market sentiment.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Higher Despite Global Selloff
events.description: Indian shares look set to open higher on Monday despite a sharp sell-off on Wall Street Friday, sparked by an unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade.

events.title: Thai Stock Market Likely Rangebound On Monday
events.description: The Thai stock market turned lower again on Friday, one day after ending the three-day slide in which it had given up almost 35 points or 2.2 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,450-point plateau and it's expected to remain in that neighborhood again on Monday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Stop The Bleeding On Monday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in five straight sessions, retreating more than 175 points or 3.1 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 5,150-point plateau although it's poised to open to the upside on Monday.

events.title: Australian Markets Slightly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is slightly lower on Monday, extending the losses in the previous seven sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,600.00 level, with weakness in financial and technology stocks nearly offset by gains in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Due For Support
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has finished lower in four straight sessions, sinking almost 900 points or 3.8 percent in that span. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 22,400-point plateau although it may halt its slide on Monday.

events.title: Steady Start Eyes For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market has moved lower in two straight sessions, sliding more than 50 points or 1.4 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,530-point plateau although it may find traction on Monday.
